section.content: The machine learning device includes a processor that processes data samples, and a storage device that stores results of the processing. The processor creates a plurality of identifiers from a plurality of learning databases. The plurality of learning databases respectively store a plurality of learning data samples. The processor creates an evaluation result of the recognition performance of each of the plurality of recognizers, and determines one of the plurality of learning databases and the recognizers generated from the one learning database as a learning database and a recognizers to be used based on the evaluation result.
机器学习装置包含：处理器，其处理数据样本；以及存储装置，其储存处理的结果。处理器根据多个学习数据库制作多个识别器。多个学习数据库分别储存多个学习数据样本。处理器制作多个识别器各自的识别性能的评价结果，根据评价结果，将多个学习数据库中的一个学习数据库以及根据所述一个学习数据库生成的识别器决定为要使用的学习数据库以及识别器。

The present application claims priority from japanese patent application 2019-181165, which is filed on 1/10/2019, and is incorporated by reference to the content thereof.

Technical Field

The present invention relates to machine learning, and is applicable to, for example, an image processing technique using machine learning for detecting a specific object (for example, a cancer cell, a bubble on a liquid surface, or the like) included in a captured image.

Background

In recent years, image recognition techniques using machine learning and the like have been studied. By using DEEP LEARNING (deep learning) or the like, the detection accuracy of an object within an image is improved. In order to develop a recognizer for detecting an object in an image, for example, a technique proposed in patent document 1 is proposed. In patent document 1, a plurality of learning image data sets are set to perform machine learning, and parameters of a neural network are calculated.

Prior art literature

Patent literature

Patent document 1 Japanese patent laid-open publication 2016-143351

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

However, as in patent document 1, even if a learning image is divided into a plurality of image groups and a parameter is obtained by relearning, there is a case where an image that does not contribute to improvement in recognition accuracy of the recognizer is included in the image groups, and the recognition accuracy of the recognizer is not necessarily improved. In addition, patent document 1 cannot create a learning image database capable of continuously improving the recognition accuracy of the recognizer.

Means for solving the problems

A machine learning device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a processor that processes a data sample, and a storage device that stores a result of the processing. The processor creates a plurality of recognizers according to a plurality of learning databases, the plurality of learning databases respectively store a plurality of learning data samples, creates evaluation results of recognition performances of the plurality of recognizers, and decides one learning database in the plurality of learning databases and the recognizers generated according to the one learning database as a learning database to be used and the recognizers according to the evaluation results.

Further features relating to the present invention will become apparent from the description of the present specification and the accompanying drawings. The embodiments of the present invention are realized by means of elements, combinations of elements, and detailed description and appended claims. The description of the present invention is merely a typical example, and it should be understood that the present invention is not limited to the embodiments and application examples of the present invention in any way.

Effects of the invention

According to an embodiment of the present invention, an appropriate learning database and identifier can be created and used.

Detailed Description

In one embodiment, a plurality of discriminators are created by performing machine learning using each image of a learning image database, the created discriminators are evaluated to obtain evaluation results, and the plurality of evaluation results are determined to control updating availability of the discriminators and the learning image database. Thus, a machine learning device and a method for creating a learning image database composed of a recognizer capable of recognizing an object (for example, tissue, cell, or the like) in an image with high accuracy and an image contributing to the improvement of the continued recognition accuracy of the recognizer are provided.

Hereinafter, embodiments of the present invention will be described with reference to the drawings. In the drawings, functionally identical elements are sometimes indicated by identical reference numerals. Furthermore, the drawings illustrate specific embodiments and examples of installations that follow the principles of the present invention, but are not intended to be limiting in any way for understanding the present invention.

In the present embodiment, the present invention has been described in sufficient detail for those skilled in the art to practice the present invention, but it is to be understood that other arrangements and modes are possible, and that structural and structural changes and substitutions of various elements can be made without departing from the scope and spirit of the technical idea of the present invention. Therefore, the following description is not limited to this explanation.

As described later, the embodiments of the present invention may be installed by software running on a general-purpose computer, or may be installed by dedicated hardware or a combination of software and hardware. Hereinafter, each process in the embodiment of the present invention will be described with "each processing unit (e.g., learning unit, etc.) as a program" as a subject (operation subject), but the process specified by the execution of the program by a processor (CPU, etc.) may be performed while using a memory and a communication port (communication control device), so that the description with the processor as a subject may be performed.

(1) First embodiment

< Functional Structure of machine learning device >

Fig. 1 is a block diagram showing a functional configuration of a machine learning device according to a first embodiment. The machine learning device 1 includes an input unit 10, a learning unit 11, an adaptability evaluation unit 12, an update determination unit 13, a drawing unit 14, a control unit 91, a learning image Database (DB) (determination) 100, a learning image DB (before determination+determination) 101, an evaluation image 102, and a memory 90. The machine learning device 1 may be installed in an image acquisition device such as an image diagnosis support device, or may be installed in a server connected to the image acquisition device via a network as described later (third to fourth embodiments).

The input unit 10, the learning unit 11, the suitability evaluation unit 12, the update determination unit 13, and the drawing unit 14 in the machine learning device 1 may be realized by a program or a processor executing the program, or may be realized by hardware modules.

The image data is input to the input unit 10. For example, the input unit 10 may acquire encoded still image data or the like in the form of JPG, jpeg2000, PNG, BMP, or the like, which is captured at predetermined time intervals by a capturing means such as a camera (not shown in fig. 1) incorporated in an image capturing device, as an input image.

The input unit 10 may extract still image data of a frame at a predetermined interval from moving image data of MotionJPEG, MPEG, h.264, HD/SDI format, or the like, and acquire the image as an input image. The input unit 10 may acquire an input image from a photographing unit via a bus, a network, or the like. The input section 10 may take an image already stored in a detachable recording medium as an input image. The image input from the input section 10 is stored as a learning image (before determination) in the learning image DB (before determination+determination) 101.

The learning image DB (determination) 100 stores a plurality of combinations of learning images, determined images, and positive solution tags. Positive solution tags corresponding to the respective images are determined. The learning image (before determination) is composed of a plurality of combinations of a learning image, an image before determination, and a positive solution label. The forward decomposition label corresponding to each image can be changed.

The learning unit 11 performs machine learning to recognize an image of a specific object in the input image as the specific object, for example, to recognize an image of normal tissue or cells as normal tissue or cells, and to recognize an image of abnormal tissue or cells in the input image as abnormal tissue or cells. The learning unit 11 creates a recognizer CA (parameters (filter coefficients, offset values, etc.) necessary for recognition) from the learning image DB (determination) 100. The learning unit 11 creates the recognizer CB based on a learning image DB (before determination) 101 obtained by adding the learning image (before determination) input from the input unit 10 to the learning image DB (before determination) 100.

The adaptability evaluation unit 12 calculates recognition results and recognition values of the recognizers CA, CB using the evaluation image 102. The update determination unit 13 controls whether or not the identifiers CA and the learning image DB (determination) 100 are updated using the identification results and the identification values of the identifiers CA and CB obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12. The update determination unit 13 also stores information such as Ave dr1、Avedr2, each M drN, the identifier CA determined by the update determination unit 13, the number of updates of the learning image DB (determination), and the transition of Ave dr1 after the update, which are obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12, in the memory 90.

The drawing unit 14 outputs information such as Ave dr1、Avedr2, M drN, the identifier CA determined by the update determination unit 13, the number of updates of the learning image DB (determination), and the transition of Ave dr1 after updating, which are obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12, to an output device such as a display or a printer.

The control unit 91 is implemented by, for example, a processor executing a program, and is connected to each element in the machine learning device 1. Each component of the machine learning device 1 operates as described above, either autonomously or in response to an instruction from the control unit 91.

As described above, in the machine learning device 1 of the present embodiment, the learning unit 11 performs machine learning, generates the identifier CA from the learning image DB (determination) 100, and creates the identifier CB from the learning image DB (before determination) 101 obtained by adding the learning image (before determination) input from the input unit 10 to the learning image DB (determination) 100. The adaptability evaluation unit 12 calculates recognition results and recognition values of the recognizers CA, CB using the evaluation image 102. The update determination unit 13 controls whether or not the identifiers CA and the learning image DB (determination) 100 are updated using the identification results and the identification values of the identifiers CA and CB obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12.

< Hardware Structure of machine learning device >

Fig. 2A is a diagram showing an example of the hardware configuration of the machine learning device 1 according to the first embodiment. The machine learning device 1 includes a CPU (processor) 201 that executes various programs, a memory 202 (main storage device) that stores various programs, and an auxiliary storage device 203 (corresponding to the memory 90) that stores various data. The machine learning device 1 further includes an output device 204 for outputting a recognition result, a recognizer, and a result of updating availability of the learning image DB (determination) 100, an input device 205 for inputting an instruction of a user, an image, and the like, and a communication apparatus 206 for communicating with other devices. These components in the machine learning device 1 are connected to each other via a bus 207.

The CPU201 reads in various programs from the memory 202 as needed and executes them. The memory 202 stores an input unit 10, a learning unit 11, an adaptability evaluation unit 12, an update determination unit 13, and a drawing unit 14 as programs.

The auxiliary storage device 203 stores the learning image (before the determination), the parameters of the identifiers CA, CB generated by the learning unit 11, the identification result and the identification value generated by the suitability evaluation unit 12, and the update result determined by the update determination unit 13. The auxiliary storage 203 also stores a learning image DB (determination) 100, a learning image DB (before determination+determination) 101, position information for drawing a detection frame generated by the drawing section 14, and the like. The memory 202, the secondary storage 203, or a combination thereof is a storage device.

The output device 204 includes a display, a printer, a speaker, and other devices. For example, the output device 204 is a display device, and displays the data generated by the drawing unit 14 on a screen. The input device 205 includes devices such as a keyboard, a mouse, and a microphone. An instruction of the user (including a decision of learning an image (before determination) input) is input to the machine learning device 1 through the input device 205.

The communication device 206 is not necessarily required in the machine learning apparatus 1, and in the case where the communication device is included in a personal computer or the like connected to the image acquisition apparatus, the machine learning apparatus 1 may not hold the communication device 206. The communication device 206 receives data (including images) transmitted from another device (e.g., a server) connected via a network, for example, and stores the received data in the auxiliary storage device 203.

The machine learning device according to the present embodiment performs machine learning using the images of the learning image database to create a plurality of discriminators, and evaluates the created plurality of discriminators to obtain an evaluation result. The machine learning device determines the evaluation result and controls the updating availability of the identifier and the learning image database, thereby making it possible to create a learning image database composed of identifiers capable of recognizing objects (e.g., tissues, cells, etc.) in images with higher accuracy and images contributing to improving the continued recognition accuracy of the identifiers.

< Structure and action of each part >

The structure and operation of each element will be described in detail below.

(I) Learning unit 11

Fig. 2B shows an example of the structure of the learning unit 11. The learning unit 11 includes a feature extraction unit 111, a local recognition unit 112, and an overall recognition unit 113.

(I-i) feature extraction section 111

The feature extraction unit 111 obtains a feature amount of the input image. Fig. 3 shows an example of obtaining the feature quantity. CNN representation Convolutional Neural Network (convolutional neural network) of fig. 3. For example, the feature extraction unit 111 obtains a feature quantity FAi of an object (for example, tissue, cell, or the like) of the input image Ai from the input image Ai using a feature extractor FEA that performs the operation of equation 1.

The learning unit 11 obtains the filter coefficients wj by machine learning to identify the image of each object as each object (identify normal tissue, normal cells as normal tissue, normal cells, or identify abnormal tissue, abnormal cells as abnormal tissue, abnormal cells, or the like). pj represents a pixel value, bi represents an offset value, m represents the number of filter coefficients, and h represents a nonlinear function.

As shown in fig. 4, the feature extraction unit 111 obtains the calculation result of each filter 42 from the top left to the bottom right for the target image (pathological tissue image, for example) 41 by using formula 1, and thereby obtains the feature value fi of an arbitrary filter i. For example, the matrix of the feature quantity fi obtained by the feature extractor a is set as the feature quantity FAi of the input image Ai. The method for producing the feature extractor FEA will be described later.

(I-ii) local recognition portion 112

As shown in fig. 5, the local recognition unit 112 calculates a value of the object similarity (for example, lesion similarity) for each local region by equation 2 using the feature quantity FAi of the feature extractor FEA obtained by the feature extraction unit 111 and the nonlinear function NF (for example, sigmoid function). The local recognition unit 112 determines whether or not the object in the input image Ai is an object to be detected (for example, a normal cell, an abnormal cell, or the like) based on the calculated value.

For example, the local recognition value may be calculated by applying Convolution a process or a nonlinear function or the like a plurality of times, or the feature quantity in each coordinate may be input to another recognition method such as Random forest or SVM.

As shown in fig. 6, the overall recognition unit 113 obtains the base recognition value BS using the local recognition value LS obtained by the local recognition unit 112 and a nonlinear function (e.g., sigmoid function, etc.). The overall recognition unit 113 determines whether or not the object in the input image Ai is an object (for example, a normal cell, an abnormal cell, or the like) to be detected, using the basic recognition value BS as a calculation result R indicating a value of the object similarity (for example, lesion similarity, or the like) of each object image in the input image (S1).

The base identification value BS is calculated using the large office identification value GS of formula 3 and formula 4.

Further, the averaging processing in the horizontal and vertical directions is not limited, and sum processing or the like may be used.

The learning unit 11 learns the feature amounts of the respective objects using a conventional machine learning technique so that the overall recognition unit 113 recognizes the respective objects in the input image as the respective objects using the local recognition values (for example, recognizes normal tissue and normal cells as normal tissue and normal cells, recognizes abnormal tissue and abnormal cells as abnormal tissue and abnormal cells), and obtains the coefficients of the filter W and the offset value B. For example, convolutional Neural Network may be used as a machine learning technique.

As shown in fig. 7, the learning unit 11 calculates the feature quantity FAi of the input image Ai by equation 1 using the input image Ai (for example, a pathology image) by machine learning in advance. Next, the learning unit 11 obtains the local recognition value LS from the feature quantity FAi by the formula 2. The learning unit 11 calculates the parameters of formulas 1 to 3 using the basic identification value BS obtained from the local identification value LS to determine the image of each object as each object (for example, determine an abnormal tissue and an abnormal cell as an abnormal tissue and an abnormal cell, and determine a normal tissue and a normal cell as a normal tissue and a normal cell).

The learning unit 11 repeats the processing of the feature extraction unit 111, the local recognition unit 112, and the global recognition unit 113 using a plurality of learning images of the learning image DB (specification) 100, and obtains the parameters (filter coefficient wj, coefficient of the filter W, offset values bi, B, and the like) shown in equations 1,2, and 3.

The learning unit 11 creates a recognizer CA including a feature extractor for calculating a feature amount of an input image from the input image, a local recognizer for obtaining a local recognition value, and a local recognizer for obtaining a local recognition value. Similarly, the learning unit 11 obtains parameters (filter coefficient wj, coefficient of filter W, offset values bi, B, and the like) shown in equations 1,2, and 3 using a plurality of learning images of the learning image DB (before determination+determination) 101, and creates the identifier CB. The learning unit 11 stores the obtained parameters (filter coefficient wj, coefficient of filter W, offset values bi and B, etc.) in the memory 90.

For example, the learning unit 11 adjusts the balance of the number of images of the recognition type of each of the learning image DB (determination) 100 and the learning image DB (before determination+determination) 101, and creates the recognizers CA and CB. For example, the learning unit 11 adjusts the number of images in the learning image DB (determination) 100 and the learning image DB (before determination+determination) 101, respectively, so that the difference in the number of images between the recognition types is smaller than a predetermined threshold. This enables more appropriate evaluation.

(Ii) Adaptability evaluation unit 12

The suitability evaluation unit 12 uses the evaluation image 102, and obtains Ave drX(Avedr1 of the identifier CA and Ave drX(Avedr2 of the identifier CB for the identifiers CA and CB produced by the learning unit 11 according to the formula 5), thereby evaluating these identifiers. In formula 5, N represents the number of types to be identified. Each M drN represents the detection rate of the object. For example, n=2, M dr1 represents benign tumor detection rate (average), and M dr2 represents malignant tumor detection rate (average). The adaptability evaluation unit 12 may use a value different from Ave drX, for example, the maximum value of M drN may be used.

[ Math 5]

Ave drX＝(Mdr1+…+MdrN)/n

(Iii) Update determination unit 13

The update determination unit 13 compares the Ave drX obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12 to control whether or not the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination) 100 are updated. For example, in the case where Ave dr2＞Avedr1 and Ave dr2 > TH1 (for example, th1=0.7) (K1), the update determination unit 13 performs update of the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination) 100. Specifically, the update determination unit 13 updates the content of the learning image DB (determination) 100 to the content of the learning image DB (determination+pre-determination) 101, and updates the identifier CA to the content of the identifier CB learned by the learning image DB (determination+pre-determination) 101.

In addition, in the case where Ave dr2≤Avedr1 is equal to Ave dr2 > TH1 (K2), the update determination unit 13 does not update the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination), and for example, randomly replaces the order of the images of the learning image DB (before determination). The learning unit 11 performs relearning by replacing the sequential learning image DB (before determination). In the case where K1 is neither present nor K2 is present, the update determination unit 13 changes the positive solution labels of several images in the learning image DB (before determination) for relearning in accordance with a user-based designation via the input device or automatically. For example, the update determination unit 13 may determine whether or not the correct label is changed for each small image.

The update determination unit 13 records Ave dr1、Avedr2, each M drN, the identifier CA determined by the update determination unit 13, the number of updates of the learning image DB (determination) 100, the transition of Ave dr1 after the update, and the like, which are obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12, in the memory 90 or the log file.

(Iv) Drawing part 14

As an example, the drawing unit 14 displays Ave dr1、Avedr2 obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12, each M drN, the identifier CA determined by the update determination unit 13, the number of updates of the learning image DB (the number of determinations), the transition of Ave dr1 after the update, and the like through a GUI (graphical user interface) shown in fig. 11. With respect to the example of fig. 11, ave dr1 is shown as 0.71, ave dr2 is shown as 0.81, M dr1 is shown as 0.80, M dr2 is shown as 0.82, and the number of updates is shown as 10.

The drawing unit 14 displays the recognition result of each recognizer of the unknown image input from the input unit 10. In the case where a specific portion in the image is determined to be an object to be detected (e.g., abnormal tissue or abnormal cell), the drawing unit 14 may draw a detection frame 82 in the input target image 81 in order to indicate a portion of the object to be detected (e.g., a portion in which abnormal tissue or abnormal cell is suspected), as shown in fig. 8. On the other hand, when the target image 81 is determined to be a normal tissue or a normal cell, the drawing unit 14 may not draw the detection frame 82 on the input target image 81 and may directly display the input target image 81.

As shown in fig. 8, the drawing unit 14 displays the result (for example, tumor) 83 of the determined object similarity. The drawing unit 14 is not necessarily required as the machine learning device 1, and in the case where the drawing unit is included in the image diagnosis support apparatus, the machine learning device 1 may not hold the drawing unit 14.

< Procedure of machine learning device >

Fig. 9 is a flowchart for explaining the operation of the learning unit 11 of the machine learning device 1 according to the first embodiment. The following description will be made with the learning unit 11 as the main operation body, but the CPU201 may be replaced by the main operation body, and the CPU201 executes each processing unit as a program.

(I) Step 901

The input unit 10 receives the learning input image Ai, and outputs the learning input image Ai to the learning unit 11.

(Ii) Step 902

The learning unit 11 obtains feature amounts of objects (for example, tissues, cells, and the like) in the input image Ai by machine learning using a filter according to the above-described formula 1, and creates a feature extractor FEA. The learning unit 11 obtains a filter coefficient wj and an offset value bi for the feature quantity FAi.

(Iii) Step 903

The learning unit 11 determines whether or not the object in the input image Ai is an object to be detected (for example, a normal cell, an abnormal cell, or the like) by calculating a local recognition value LS from the feature quantity FAi by machine learning, calculating a value of object similarity (for example, lesion similarity, or the like) for each local region, and calculating parameters (coefficients of the filter W, the offset value B, or the like) of the formula 2 for calculating the local recognition value according to formula 2.

(Iv) Step 904

The learning unit 11 obtains the parameters (the coefficient of the filter W, the offset value B, and the like) of the equation 3 by machine learning using the basic recognition value BS obtained from the local recognition value LS to determine the image of each target object as each target object (for example, determine an abnormal tissue and an abnormal cell as an abnormal tissue and an abnormal cell, and determine a normal tissue and a normal cell as a normal tissue and a normal cell).

(V) Step 905

The learning unit 11 stores the parameters (filter coefficient wj, coefficient of filter W, offset values bi, B, etc.) of equations 1, 2, and 3 in the memory 90.

Fig. 10 is a flowchart for explaining the operation of the machine learning device 1 according to the present embodiment. Hereinafter, each processing unit (the input unit 10, the learning unit 11, etc.) is described as an operation subject, but the CPU201 may be replaced by an operation subject, and the CPU201 executes each processing unit as a program.

(I) Step 1001

The input unit 10 outputs an input image Ai of the learning image DB (before the determination+determination) to the learning unit 11.

(Ii) Step 1002

The learning unit 11 reads the parameters of equations 1,2 and 3 related to the identifier CA from the memory 90. The learning unit 11 also performs machine learning using the learning image DB (before determination+determination) 101, and calculates each parameter of equations 1,2, and 3 relating to the identifier CB.

(Iii) Step 1003

The suitability evaluation unit 12 calculates Ave dr1 of the identifier CA and Ave dr2 of the identifier CB according to equation 5 using the respective parameters and evaluation images of the identifiers CA and CB.

(Iv) Step 1004

The update determination unit 13 compares the calculated Ave dr1 with Ave dr2. In the case of Ave dr2＞Avedr1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1006. On the other hand, if the calculation result is Ave dr2≤Avedr1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1006.

(V) Step 1005

In the case where Ave dr2 > TH1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1007. On the other hand, when Ave dr2 is equal to or less than TH1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1008.

(Vi) Step 1006

In the case where Ave dr2 > TH1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1008. On the other hand, if Ave dr2 is equal to or less than TH1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1009.

(Vii) Step 1007

The update determination unit 13 updates the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination) 100.

(Viii) Step 1008

The update determination unit 13 exchanges the order of the images of the learning image DB (before the determination+determination).

(Ix) Step 1009

The update determination unit 13 replaces the forward solution tag of the learning image DB (before determination).

(X) Step 1010

The update determination unit 13 checks whether or not the update determination is completed for all the images of the learning image DB (determination+before determination), and if so, proceeds to step 1011. On the other hand, if not, the update determination unit 13 returns to step 1002 and repeats steps 1002 to 1009.

(Xi) Step 1011

The update determination unit 13 stores the information of the identifier CA in the memory 90 (corresponding to the auxiliary storage device 203).

As described above, even when the learning image database contains an image that does not contribute to improvement of the recognition accuracy of the recognizer, the machine learning apparatus automatically determines an image that contributes to improvement of the recognition accuracy of the recognizer, and controls updating availability of the recognizer and the learning image database based on the determination result. More specifically, the machine learning device performs machine learning using each image of the plurality of learning image databases to create a plurality of identifiers, and evaluates the created plurality of identifiers to obtain an evaluation result. The machine learning device determines a plurality of evaluation results to control updating availability of the identifier and the learning image database, and determines the learning image database and the identifier to be used. This makes it possible to create a learning image database composed of a recognizer capable of recognizing an object (for example, tissue, cells, or the like) in an image with high accuracy and an image contributing to improvement of the continued recognition accuracy of the recognizer.

In addition, even if the learning image to be input includes images that do not contribute to improving the recognition accuracy of the recognizer, the learning image database can be created by excluding these images. Even when the input learning image does not contribute to improvement of the recognition accuracy of the recognizer at this point in time, the input learning image can be used as an image contributing to improvement of the recognition accuracy of the recognizer by changing the order of the images to be learned and then learning again.

(2) Second embodiment

The second embodiment will be described below. The machine learning device 1 according to the second embodiment shown in fig. 12 includes a plurality of constituent elements similar to those of fig. 1 according to the first embodiment, but includes a learning image DB (before determination) 201 and an update determination unit 23 in place of the learning image DB (before determination) 101 according to the first embodiment. Hereinafter, a structure different from that of fig. 1 will be mainly described.

The machine learning device 1 of the present embodiment performs machine learning using each image of the learning image database to create a plurality of discriminators, and evaluates the created plurality of discriminators to obtain an evaluation result. The machine learning device 1 determines a plurality of evaluation results to control updating availability or creation of the identifier and the learning image database. Thus, for example, a learning image database suitable for each facility or each time period can be created, the learning image database being composed of a recognizer capable of recognizing an object (for example, tissue, cell, or the like) in an image with high accuracy and an image contributing to improvement in the continuous recognition accuracy of the recognizer.

< Structure and action of each part >

The structure and operation of each element different from those of fig. 1 will be described in detail below.

(I) Learning image DB (before determination) 201

The learning image DB (before determination) 201 stores images input from the input unit 10, and does not store other images.

(Ii) Update determination unit 23

The learning unit 11 creates the identifier CA from the learning image DB (determination) 100, and creates the identifier CB from the learning image DB (before determination) 201. The suitability evaluation unit 12 obtains Ave dr1 of the identifier CA and Ave dr2 of the identifier CB using the evaluation image, and thereby evaluates the identifier. The update determination unit 23 compares the Ave drX obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12, and controls whether or not the identifiers CA, CB, the learning image DB (determination) 100, and the learning image DB (before determination) 201 are updated or created.

That is, in the case of Ave dr2＞Avedr1, the identifier CB manufactured from the learning image DB (before determination) 201 collected at another facility or other time is more suitable for the recognition of the evaluation image than the identifier CA manufactured from the learning image DB (before determination) 100 collected previously, for example, for all the images of the evaluation image. Therefore, unlike the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination), the update determination unit 23 stores the identifier CB and the learning image DB (before determination) in a group with the evaluation image.

In the case of Ave dr2≤Avedr1, the identifier CA produced from the previously collected learning image DB (before determination) is more suitable for the identification of the evaluation image than the identifier CB produced from, for example, the learning image DB (before determination) collected at other facilities or other times. Therefore, the update determination unit 23 stores the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination) in a group with the evaluation image.

< Hardware Structure of machine learning device >

The hardware configuration example of the machine learning device 1 of the present embodiment has the same configuration as that of fig. 2, but unlike the machine learning device 1 of the first embodiment, the update determination unit 23 is included in the memory 202.

The auxiliary storage 203 of the machine learning device 1 stores the calculation result Ave drX obtained by the suitability evaluation unit 12, the identifiers CA, CB determined by the update determination unit 23, the learning image DB (determination) 100, the learning image DB (before determination) 201, the evaluation image, the parameters of the formulas 1,2, and 3 generated by the learning unit 11, and the like.

Fig. 13 is a flowchart for explaining the operation of the machine learning device 1 according to the present embodiment. Hereinafter, each processing unit (the input unit 10, the learning unit 11, etc.) is described as an operation subject, but the CPU201 may be replaced by an operation subject, and the CPU201 executes each processing unit as a program.

(I) Step 1301

The input unit 10 outputs an input image Ai of the learning image DB (before determination) 201 to the learning unit 11.

(Ii) Step 1302

The learning unit 11 reads the parameters of equations 1, 2 and 3 related to the identifier CA from the memory 90. Further, machine learning is performed using the learning image DB (before determination) 201, and parameters of equations 1, 2, and 3 relating to the identifier CB are calculated.

(Iii) Step 1303

The suitability evaluation unit 12 calculates Ave dr1 of the identifier CA and Ave dr2 of the identifier CB according to equation 5 using the respective parameters and evaluation images of the identifiers CA and CB.

(Iv) Step 1304

The update determination unit 13 compares the calculated Ave dr1 with Ave dr2. In the case of Ave dr2＞Avedr1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1305. On the other hand, in the case of Ave dr2≤Avedr1, the update determination unit 13 proceeds to step 1306.

(V) Step 1305

The update determination unit 13 stores the identifier CB, the learning image DB (before determination) 201, the evaluation image, and the calculation result (Ave dr2、Avedr1) in the memory 90 (corresponding to the auxiliary storage 203) in a group.

(Vi) Step 1306

The update determination unit 13 stores the identifier CA, the learning image DB (determination) 100, the evaluation image, and the calculation result (Ave dr2、Avedr1) in the memory 90 (corresponding to the auxiliary storage 203) in a group.

(Vii) Step 1307

The update determination unit 13 checks whether or not the update determination is completed with respect to all the images of the learning image DB (before determination) 201, and if so, ends the processing. On the other hand, if not, the update determination unit 13 returns to step 1302, and repeats steps 1302 to 1306.

In the second embodiment, a plurality of discriminators are created by performing machine learning using each image of a plurality of learning image databases, and the created discriminators are evaluated to obtain an evaluation result. The second embodiment determines a plurality of evaluation results to control updating availability or creation of the identifier and the learning image database, and determines the learning image database and the identifier to be used. Thus, a recognizer and a learning image database that can recognize objects (e.g., tissues, cells, etc.) in an image of each facility with high accuracy can be obtained.

Further, by creating data by grouping the identifier, the learning image DB, the evaluation image, and the calculation result, it is possible to determine the performance of the identifier created from data of other facilities (hospitals, etc.) by comparing the calculation results.

Further, by changing the evaluation image to image data of an arbitrary facility, it is possible to determine which facility identifier the image of the facility uses, and it is possible to identify an object in the image with high accuracy.

The machine learning device 1 may hold a plurality of learning image DBs (determinations) 100, and perform the above-described processing between each of the plurality of learning image DBs (determinations) 100 and the learning image DB (before determination) 201. Thus, a more appropriate learning image DB and recognizer can be obtained.

(4) Fourth embodiment

The server 1503 includes an image diagnosis support apparatus 5 and a storage unit 1502 that stores the identifier output from the machine learning apparatus 1 of the image diagnosis support apparatus 5. As described above, according to the fourth embodiment, a network trusted service providing system can be provided. Specifically, the network trusted service providing system performs machine learning on objects (for example, tissues, cells, and the like) in images transmitted from facilities and the like having different places, so as to classify the objects into objects to be detected (for example, normal tissues, normal cells, abnormal tissues, abnormal cells, abnormal tissues, cells, and the like), and creates a recognizer. The network trusted service providing system transmits the identifier to a facility or the like having a different place, and reads the identifier by an image acquisition device located in the facility or the like. The identifier in the image acquisition apparatus classifies whether or not an object (e.g., abnormal tissue, abnormal cell, etc.) to be detected is an object (e.g., tissue, cell, etc.) in a new image.
